name: Zashiki-mawashi
source:
A heartwarming, cheerful, and comically spooky story about a family considering buying a standalone house to escape homelessness—only to discover it’s haunted by a zashiki-warashi (a protective child spirit of Japanese folklore) and an old electric fan that seems to have a will of its own.

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/zashiki-mawashi-switch/]Nintendo[/url]]
